run_ltx2_denoising_stage: run the LTX2DenoisingStage class to perform joint video and audio denoising with CFG and stage-1 guider
build_ltx2_model_inputs: build LTX2ModelInputs dataclass with latent model inputs, audio latents, timesteps, and attention masks
prepare_ltx2_denoising_loop: prepare LTX2DenoisingContext with audio latents, SP sharding state, and TI2V clean latent conditioning
build_ltx2_guidance_pass_spec: build LTX2GuidancePassSpec to configure conditional, negative, perturbed, and modality forward passes
repeat_ltx2_model_kwargs_batch: repeat LTX2 model kwargs dict along batch dimension for CFG and multi-pass batching
